task: Resolve and record every mutable desktop and service path for a fresh QA run root, launch the actual Electron app only after isolation is proven, and create one uniquely named garden.
successCriteria: Electron userData, Breadboard database, Quartz content, conversations, artifacts, skills, logs, caches, and agent state resolve below the QA run root
the uniquely named garden is present only in isolated QA state
no normal Breadboard user-data path or unrelated repository data is read or modified
no secret or capability token is captured in diagnostics

task: From the Electron renderer, exercise an allowed dashboard-to-Quartz navigation and attempt an untrusted external navigation while the QA harness intercepts OS external-open actions.
successCriteria: dashboard and configured Quartz loopback origins remain usable
untrusted content cannot replace the Electron renderer
an allowed external link is delegated through the restricted external-open path rather than loaded with privileged renderer access
no privileged popup or unexpected BrowserWindow is created

task: Inspect the renderer-visible desktop bridge in the launched application and exercise its documented harmless methods without importing Node modules or accessing filesystem, process, or secret values.
successCriteria: the narrow typed Breadboard desktop API is available where expected
Node integration, arbitrary filesystem access, and command execution are unavailable to renderer content
service secrets and capability tokens are absent from the bridge
the renderer remains sandboxed and context-isolated

task: Launch Breadboard from a cold isolated state, observe the local startup window and progress, continue through the welcome gate like a user, and reach the dashboard window.
successCriteria: Electron launches and shows a visible startup or recovery surface
startup progress does not freeze or become a blank page
the welcome continuation swaps to the preloaded dashboard window
the primary dashboard becomes interactable without a fatal main-process or renderer error

task: Launch Electron and wait on product readiness signals for the required ChatMock, Quartz, and dashboard service graph before using initial navigation.
successCriteria: each required service reaches its meaningful health condition within its bounded startup timeout
dependency ordering does not surface a false ready state
initial dashboard navigation succeeds
an optional unavailable service does not make the whole application unusable

task: After reaching the dashboard and performing a harmless navigation, close Breadboard through the supported Electron lifecycle and inspect only processes and ports owned by the QA run.
successCriteria: the main and renderer processes exit cleanly
supervised child services stop in dependency-safe order
no QA-owned child or grandchild process remains orphaned
QA-owned ports are released and unrelated processes remain untouched

task: Create a QA garden, close the Electron application cleanly, relaunch it with the same isolated QA data root, sign in if required, and return to that garden.
successCriteria: the second launch uses the same isolated QA state and fresh service processes
the garden and intended account/session state survive application restart
the garden opens and its durable content is intact
no stale child process or port conflict prevents relaunch

task: Create durable garden and conversation state, reload the Electron renderer, and verify that the application returns to a usable surface without losing persisted state.
successCriteria: renderer reload does not crash or strand a blank window
the garden remains available
completed conversation state remains available
controls are enabled and the user can continue working

task: After the dashboard is ready, terminate one QA-owned required service through the harness, observe the desktop supervisor's bounded recovery, and then navigate in the recovered application.
successCriteria: the failure is visible in structured diagnostics rather than silent
the supervisor applies its configured bounded restart policy
the recovered service reaches a meaningful health state
the dashboard becomes usable again without spawning duplicate service trees

task: Launch Breadboard with the QA data root and fixture directory nested under paths containing spaces, then create a garden and ingest a small Markdown file.
successCriteria: Electron and every required service launch successfully from the spaced paths
the data-directory override is parsed as one absolute path
the fixture is ingested and visible in the garden
shutdown leaves no stale process caused by quoting or path-separator errors

task: In a first-run isolated desktop profile, use the local registration and login UI with QA-only credentials and reach the authenticated dashboard.
successCriteria: the invite-only local registration flow is discoverable in the desktop experience
a QA account can be created without exposing generated secrets
login succeeds and redirects to the dashboard
refresh preserves the intended authenticated session

task: Create a uniquely named QA garden from the dashboard, enter it, rename it and update its description, navigate away, and return from the dashboard.
successCriteria: the garden is created once and opens successfully
the new name and description are visible after editing
the garden remains listed after navigating away and back
returning to the garden shows the updated durable state

task: Create a top-level garden folder and a nested folder, move a QA garden into the nested folder using the visible dashboard controls, collapse and expand the tree, then refresh.
successCriteria: both folder levels are created without duplicate or malformed paths
the garden appears under the intended nested folder
collapse and expand preserve the correct tree relationships
folder placement survives renderer refresh

task: Create two distinct QA gardens, use the dashboard search to isolate one by name, clear the search, and switch between the implemented garden display modes.
successCriteria: search returns the matching garden and hides the non-match
clearing search restores both gardens
each implemented view mode renders the same underlying gardens
view switching does not duplicate or lose garden state

task: Export a QA garden containing a deterministic note through the dashboard, import that export into isolated QA state under a new name, and open the imported garden.
successCriteria: export produces a non-empty garden transfer file in the QA output directory
import completes without writing outside isolated state
the imported garden is distinct from the source
the deterministic note and its content survive the round trip

task: Enable the implemented fork permission on a QA garden, fork it through the visible UI, edit content in the fork, and verify the source garden remains unchanged.
successCriteria: the fork action creates a distinct garden with copied initial content
the fork has a unique slug and opens successfully
an edit in the fork is durable
the corresponding source-garden content is unchanged

task: Upload a small Markdown fixture containing a unique deterministic fact into a QA garden and wait on the product's ingestion state rather than sleeping.
successCriteria: the upload progresses through visible bounded states and completes
the document appears in the garden source/library UI
the extracted Markdown retains the unique deterministic fact
no silent ingestion, renderer, or service error occurs

task: Upload a small deterministic PDF fixture into a QA garden, wait for parsing and ingestion, then open the resulting document representation.
successCriteria: the PDF is accepted and reaches a terminal ingestion state
the document appears in the garden
known fixture text is available in the extracted content or PDF reading surface
fallback behavior is truthful if an optional parser is unavailable

task: Attempt to upload a harmless tiny fixture with an unsupported extension, dismiss the resulting feedback, and then upload a supported Markdown fixture.
successCriteria: the unsupported file is rejected with a clear user-visible reason
no false success state or infinite spinner appears
the upload control returns to an enabled state after dismissal
a subsequent supported upload completes successfully

task: Start ingestion of a deterministic fixture, dismiss or navigate away from the upload panel while work continues, return to the garden, and observe the final state.
successCriteria: dismissing the panel does not silently cancel the upload unless the UI promises cancellation
progress or final state can be recovered after returning
the document is either successfully ingested or has a clear terminal error
no permanent disabled control or orphan spinner remains

task: Use the Links panel to import a controlled public URL with a unique fact, wait for the Reader-to-Markdown ingestion path, and open the stored source in the garden.
successCriteria: the link job reaches a terminal visible state
a Markdown source is stored in isolated garden content
the known page fact is present in the stored source
network or Reader failure is surfaced honestly and remains retryable

task: After ingesting the deterministic Markdown fixture, ask Garden Chat a question whose answer is the fixture's unique fact.
successCriteria: the user message appears once
the response reaches a completed non-empty state
the answer or deterministic evidence references the ingested fact without requiring exact prose
no fatal renderer, Hermes, ChatMock, or retrieval error occurs

task: In the completed grounded conversation, ask a follow-up that refers to the prior answer without repeating the document subject.
successCriteria: the follow-up is added to the same conversation
the response completes and uses the prior turn's subject correctly
the original grounded context remains available
the composer stays usable after completion

task: Create conversation A with a unique chat-only passphrase, create conversation B and ask for that passphrase, then return to A and ask for it there.
successCriteria: conversation B does not expose chat-specific context from A
conversation A retains its own context
switching sessions does not duplicate or overwrite messages
both conversations remain independently usable

optional: durable memory feature, which must not treat the passphrase as durable profile memory

task: Create two conversations with distinct searchable text, open chat history search, locate one by its unique text, reopen it, and continue the conversation.
successCriteria: history search returns the correct conversation
opening the result restores its messages in order
sending a new turn appends to the restored session
refresh preserves the updated history

task: Branch an existing Garden Chat conversation from a completed assistant turn, send different follow-ups on the original and branch, and switch between their histories.
successCriteria: the branch starts from the selected turn
new branch messages do not appear in the original branch
new original-branch messages do not overwrite the fork
both branches survive renderer refresh

task: Attach a small deterministic text document to a chat message through the composer, send a question about it, and reopen the conversation after refresh.
successCriteria: the attachment preview shows the correct file and can be removed before send
the sent message owns exactly one attachment
the assistant response completes with useful attachment-grounded evidence
the attachment remains accessible after refresh without leaking outside QA storage

task: Start a deliberately bounded long-running chat request, use the visible stop control while it is active, then submit a small follow-up request.
successCriteria: active progress is visible before cancellation
the stop control transitions the run to a terminal cancelled or stopped state
the composer is re-enabled and no background response continues mutating the cancelled turn
a subsequent request completes normally

task: Focus the Garden Chat composer with no text or attachment, attempt submission through keyboard and button paths, then enter a valid short message.
successCriteria: empty input does not create a blank conversation turn or server request
the UI remains stable and communicates disabled/ignored behavior semantically
the composer is not permanently disabled
the subsequent valid message can be sent

task: Open the dashboard terminal through the Electron UI, submit a harmless deterministic local task that writes only inside the QA workspace, observe progress, and wait for completion.
successCriteria: the terminal task starts exactly once
progress or activity is visible while it runs
a terminal completion state and useful output appear
the output provides evidence of the requested QA-only result without direct implementation invocation

task: Start a bounded cancellable terminal task from the UI, stop it with the visible control, and then run a short deterministic terminal task.
successCriteria: the first task exposes an active state and stop control
cancellation reaches a terminal state without a stuck spinner
no cancelled child task remains active
the second terminal task starts and completes successfully

task: Submit a harmless terminal task that deterministically returns a non-zero result inside the QA workspace, inspect the visible failure, then submit a valid task.
successCriteria: the failed task has a clear terminal error state and useful redacted evidence
the UI does not claim success or remain indefinitely active
the terminal input and controls recover
the subsequent valid task completes

task: Start a bounded terminal task, reload the Electron renderer while it is active, and inspect the recovered run card until the task reaches a terminal state.
successCriteria: renderer reload does not create a duplicate task
the in-progress or recovered run card communicates truthful state
the final output or error remains attached to the original task
the terminal can be used again after the recovered task ends

task: Open the Skills surface from chat, search the available catalog for a known harmless entry, open its detail/audit information, clear the search, and return to chat.
successCriteria: the skills surface opens without blocking the conversation
search returns a stable matching skill from the cached or live catalog
detail and audit/provenance information are readable
closing the surface returns to an intact chat

task: Install a reviewed harmless public QA skill into isolated skill roots through the Skills UI, verify its state, and invoke its deterministic non-destructive capability from chat.
successCriteria: the selected skill's provenance and compatibility are visible before installation
installation writes only to isolated quarantine/approved/conditional skill roots
the UI reports the durable installed state after refresh
invocation produces the skill's deterministic effect rather than only showing an installed badge

task: Select one configured harmless agent exposed by the Garden Chat agent picker, launch a bounded QA-only task, observe its run card, and wait for a terminal result.
successCriteria: the selected agent and task are shown before launch
exactly one run starts and progress is visible
the run reaches completed or a clear useful error state within its bound
any output/artifact belongs to the initiating conversation and stays inside QA state

task: Launch a bounded cancellable task with a configured harmless agent, stop it through the run card or composer, then launch a short task with the same agent.
successCriteria: the first agent run exposes progress and a cancellation control
cancellation produces a terminal stopped state and halts further events
the conversation remains usable
a later short run starts once and reaches a terminal result

task: Ask Garden Chat to create a simple Markdown artifact with a unique heading, open the resulting inline card and artifact viewer, and inspect its content.
successCriteria: the request reaches a completed response with exactly one owned artifact
the artifact card appears in the initiating conversation
the viewer opens and shows non-empty content containing the unique heading
preview/download routes do not expose files outside isolated artifact storage

task: Create a simple artifact, reload the renderer, close and relaunch Electron with the same QA data root, reopen the originating conversation, and open the artifact again.
successCriteria: the artifact remains associated with the originating chat after refresh
the artifact remains listed after full application restart
its content and identifier are stable and non-empty
no duplicate artifact is created by either lifecycle event

task: In a garden with deterministic source material, open Learn, request a bounded syllabus/plan, review and confirm it, and wait for the learning build to reach a terminal state.
successCriteria: Learn proposes a visible plan grounded in the selected garden
confirmation starts one build and exposes bounded progress
the build completes or surfaces a clear recoverable terminal error
completed learning content is navigable and remains inside the QA garden

task: Start a bounded Learn generation, cancel it through the UI, verify restoration, then retry with the same approved plan.
successCriteria: cancellation reaches a terminal state within its timeout
the garden is restored without partial content presented as complete
controls recover and the same plan can be retried
retry creates one active build and reaches a truthful terminal result

task: Open a deterministic garden note in the embedded Quartz surface, find it through Quartz search/explorer, edit its Markdown using the implemented editor, and navigate back to the Breadboard dashboard.
successCriteria: the note is discoverable and opens in the configured Quartz origin
the editor saves a unique QA-only change to the isolated garden
the updated content survives Quartz rebuild or refresh
the dashboard back navigation returns to a usable Breadboard surface

required: Quartz search/explorer and Markdown edit UI

task: Launch the isolated desktop profile with GBrain explicitly disabled, open a garden and its assistant/status UI, and perform a chat turn that does not require GBrain.
successCriteria: the desktop reaches the dashboard without waiting indefinitely for GBrain
the UI reports disabled or unavailable knowledge retrieval truthfully
unrelated garden and chat functionality remains usable
no false healthy badge or repeated fatal probe error appears

required: isolated desktop config with GBrain disabled

task: Launch with UI-TARS disabled or unavailable, inspect the agent/operator surface, and continue a normal Garden Chat workflow.
successCriteria: UI-TARS is shown as disabled/unavailable rather than ready
attempting to select it yields useful setup or unavailable guidance
no infinite run card or false success is created
ordinary Garden Chat remains usable

task: Launch with the optional CAD service disabled or absent, select the parametric CAD capability from chat, and inspect its health/setup behavior without starting a real design run.
successCriteria: the CAD capability reports unavailable or setup-required truthfully
no run is falsely marked started or successful
the missing optional service does not block desktop startup
chat and non-CAD features remain usable

task: Open the garden video import surface with Scriberr and optional media tools disabled, provide a syntactically valid video request without uploading user media, and inspect capability feedback.
successCriteria: the surface identifies transcription as disabled or unavailable
missing ffmpeg, ffprobe, yt-dlp, or Scriberr is described without leaking configuration
no job remains stuck or falsely succeeds
the garden remains usable after dismissing the feedback

required: isolated config with video transcription disabled

task: Open the implemented Plan page, create a QA project and task, move the task between columns, add a short comment, refresh, and reopen the project.
successCriteria: the project and task are created once in isolated local state
moving the task updates the visible column without duplication
the comment remains attached to the correct task
project, task, column, and comment state survive refresh

required: Plan page and local plan routes

task: After explicit scoped human-gate approval, use the existing isolated installed-app smoke infrastructure and a supplied Windows installer to install and launch Breadboard, create minimal durable garden state, restart, verify persistence and services, exit cleanly, and uninstall through the established runner.
successCriteria: the real installer and installed executable launch from outside the checkout
the main window and packaged web assets become ready
minimal garden state survives installed-app restart in isolated user data
services recover, exit without orphan processes, and uninstall preserves the isolated evidence/data policy

required: APPROVE LOOP ACTION approval scoped to isolated install/uninstall and rollback

task: Open a Terminal conversation of a thousand messages and count what the transcript actually put in the document.
successCriteria: the transcript reports a message count of 1000
no more than forty message rows are mounted at once
the number of mounted rows matches the number of row elements in the document
the scroller still stands for the whole conversation rather than the mounted slice

task: Scroll rapidly upward and then rapidly downward through the whole conversation.
successCriteria: rows remain mounted throughout, so no blank band is ever on screen
the mounted-row ceiling holds during fast scrolling
no row index is drawn twice
the drawn row indexes are contiguous, so no row is missing from the middle

task: Select the text of a historical message in a virtualized transcript.
successCriteria: a selection made inside a mounted row returns its text
virtualization does not prevent ordinary text selection

task: Scroll away from the newest message and use the existing jump control to come back.
successCriteria: the jump control appears once the reader is away from the bottom
pressing it lands within one line of the foot of the transcript
the newest message is on screen afterwards

task: Park the viewport partway up a long transcript and confirm nothing steals it back.
successCriteria: the scroll position after reading upward is greater than zero
the viewport is unchanged after the transcript settles
measurement corrections never move the reader more than a few pixels

task: Switch from the long conversation to a short one and back again.
successCriteria: the short conversation reports its own message count and its own height
no row from the other conversation is present after a switch
each conversation opens at the top rather than partway through
the mounted-row ceiling holds after switching back
